label: Chrome cache
description: Temporary files; Chrome rebuilds these automatically.

label: Safari cache
description: Temporary files; Safari rebuilds these automatically.

label: Firefox cache
description: Temporary files; Firefox rebuilds these automatically.

label: Edge cache
description: Temporary files; Edge rebuilds these automatically.

label: Brave cache
description: Temporary files; Brave rebuilds these automatically.

label: Opera cache
description: Temporary files; Opera rebuilds these automatically.

label: Slack cache
description: Slack temporary files and Electron caches. Rebuilds as you use Slack.

label: Zoom cache
description: Zoom caches and logs. Regenerated the next time you join a meeting.

label: Discord cache
description: Discord temporary files. Rebuilds automatically.

label: Spotify cache
description: Spotify media and app caches. Tracks re-download when you play them again.

label: Adobe temp / caches
description: Adobe regenerable caches and media cache files. Safe to remove; apps rebuild as needed.

label: Electron app caches
description: Common Electron app caches (VS Code, Figma, Notion, Arc, Linear, Obsidian, Loom, Miro). Rebuild on next launch.

label: JetBrains caches
description: IntelliJ / PyCharm / WebStorm / Rider caches and logs. IDEs rebuild indexes on next open.

label: Messaging app caches
description: Telegram, WhatsApp, and Teams regenerable caches. Media may re-download when you open chats again.

label: Steam caches
description: Steam app, HTML, and shader caches. Games may rebuild shaders on next launch.

label: App caches
description: Known regenerable app caches under ~/Library/Caches.

label: User logs
description: Application log files that regenerate as apps run.

label: Xcode DerivedData
description: Xcode build intermediates. Safe to remove; next build regenerates them. The folder for this running MacSweeper build is excluded so Clean cannot delete the live app.

label: Xcode Archives
description: Old app archives from Product → Archive. Review before cleaning if you still need them.

label: iOS DeviceSupport
description: Symbol files for connected iOS devices. Xcode re-downloads when needed.

label: watchOS / tvOS DeviceSupport
description: Symbol files for connected watchOS and tvOS devices. Xcode re-downloads when needed.

label: Simulator caches
description: Simulator caches and logs. Regenerated when you run simulators again.

label: Mail downloads
description: Attachments Mail saved locally. May need re-download from the server.

label: Downloads folder
description: Everything currently in Downloads. Review carefully — may include keepers. Use age/size filters in Detail.

label: Quick Look thumbnails
description: Thumbnail caches. Finder regenerates them as you browse files.

label: Font caches
description: Font system caches. Regenerated by macOS as needed.

label: Podcast / Music media cache
description: Artwork and media service caches for Music and related apps.

label: Empty Trash
description: Permanently deletes everything currently in Trash. Off by default. May need Full Disk Access for some items.

label: node_modules
description: npm/yarn/pnpm dependency folders under project roots. Safe to remove; reinstall with your package manager. Review paths before cleaning.

label: Python virtualenvs
description: Python virtual environments under project roots. Recreate with python -m venv or your project tool.

label: Cargo target
description: Rust build output folders named target. Rebuild with cargo build. Review carefully — some non-Rust projects use a target folder.

label: Gradle caches
description: Gradle dependency caches. Next build re-downloads what’s needed.

label: CocoaPods cache
description: Downloaded pod specs and archives. pod install re-fetches as needed.

label: npm / pnpm / yarn caches
description: Package manager global caches. Next install re-downloads packages.

label: pip cache
description: Python pip download cache. Rebuilt on the next pip install.

label: Homebrew caches
description: Downloaded bottle and source caches. Homebrew re-downloads packages when needed.

label: Homebrew cleanup
description: Removes old formula versions and scrubbed caches. Run the command in Terminal — MacSweeper does not execute brew. Size is not estimated here; use Homebrew caches above to Trash downloads.

label: Docker reclaim
description: Docker Desktop data. Most reclaimable space lives in the VM disk — use docker system prune. MacSweeper does not run Docker commands.

label: Playwright / Cypress caches
description: Browser binaries and caches for Playwright, Cypress, and Puppeteer. Next test run re-downloads what’s needed.

label: Go build caches
description: Go compiler build cache. Next go build regenerates it. Module downloads under GOPATH/pkg are not included.

label: Maven cache
description: Local Maven artifact repository. Next build re-downloads dependencies.

label: Bun cache
description: Bun package install cache. Next bun install re-fetches packages.

label: Carthage cache
description: Carthage downloaded frameworks cache. carthage bootstrap re-fetches as needed.

label: Bundler / RubyGems cache
description: Ruby gem download caches. bundle install / gem install re-fetches as needed.

label: Unavailable simulators
description: Removes simulator runtimes and devices that are no longer available. Run in Terminal — MacSweeper does not execute simctl. Review carefully if you keep old device data.
